title: The Monte Carlo group at the top of the Knights of Malta, with Kissinger and Bush Sr.

tellings.quote: There's a thing called the Monte Carlo group that is at the top top of the entire nice of Malta structure.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says there is "a thing called the Monte Carlo group" sitting "at the top" of the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights, and he places Henry Kissinger, the former US Secretary of State, and George Bush Senior, the former US president, within it. Sheehan tells it as something he knows himself, and if true it would mean a small, hidden circle sits above a well-known religious order.
